existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: The `ValueSet` resource has no local structural removals, but it has one hard validation break in local designation language binding and several high-impact semantic or round-trip risks. The top concerns are `compose.include.valueSet` union-to-intersection semantics, R6-only expansion property/paging structures, and new filter operators that R4 cannot validate. The main uncertainty is operation/narrative behavior not present in the local package.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should focus on preserving expansion semantics and representability rather than filling newly required fields. Review R4 `compose.include.valueSet` arrays with more than one canonical, validate designation language codes against BCP-47/all-languages, decide how to downgrade or extend R6-only metadata and expansion structures for R4, and test strict parser/codegen behavior for new elements and enum codes.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for computable StructureDefinition deltas: both assigned definitions and relevant local terminology artifacts were available. Confidence is medium for narrative-only semantics such as detailed filter value rules and operation behavior because the rendered R6 narrative pages, official diff, Jira/change rationale, and live terminology expansions were not available locally.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
ValueSet keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 1 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 2 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 10 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is normative/FMM 5, which creates strong stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 48/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

4 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Because R4 stability pressure is strong, low-cost compatible designs should be preferred unless they clearly undermine the R6 goal.

topFindings.title: Multiple compose.include.valueSet references changed from union to intersection semantics
